description: Litecoin fee rates for confirmation targets, plus the mempool floor, read from our own litecoind. When to use: pricing an LTC payment or deciding when a transfer will confirm cheaply. Do not use: to measure backlog depth (that is ltc_get_mempool_state) or for Bitcoin fees (btc_get_fee_rates). Returns: estimates for 1/2/3/6/12/24-block targets in LTC/kvB and sat/vB, recommended fast_2_block_sat_vb / medium_6_block_sat_vb / slow_12_block_sat_vb, mempool_min_sat_vb.
name: ltc_get_fee_rates
title: Ltc Get Fee Rates
